title: Volatility
subtitle: Equity indices and commodities: realized vs implied
headline: Thursday 05 November 2026. VIX 28.2 (very high), realized 19.7%, spread +8.5 points, curve in backwardation. The market charges +5.2 points over the HAR+IV model. Top idea: sell WTI vol at the OVX level.

sections.title: S&P 500 volatility
paragraphs: The VIX closed at 28.2, the 98th percentile of its trailing year (very high). The S&P 500 realized 19.7% over the last 21 sessions (98th percentile) and 13.7% over 63. Implied sits 8.5 points above realized: options are rich against recent history.

Since 2015 the one-month variance premium (implied today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.5 points and was positive on 83% of days. Today's +8.5 spread is above that average: the seller is paid more than usual going in.

The HAR+IV model, which debiases the VIX with past realized vol, forecasts 22.9% for the next month (pure HAR-RV: 22.9%). The gap between market and model is +5.2 points, in the '4 to 6' bucket. Historically in that bucket the forward premium averaged +3.8 points and was positive 81% of the time.

sections.title: Term structure
paragraphs: Curve: VIX9D 32.7, VIX 28.2, VIX3M 25.5, VIX6M 25.3, VIX1Y 24.6. VIX / VIX3M = 1.103, backwardation (stress: near-term vol above deferred). The curve has been inverted on 7% of days since 2015.

The forward vol between 30 and 91 days is 24.2%: that is what the market charges for month two and three, below spot VIX. VVIX at 135 and CBOE SKEW at 149 (76th pct) describe the vol-of-vol and tail pricing.

sections.title: Cross-asset
paragraphs: Among the assets with a CBOE implied index, S&P 500 has the richest options (IV 28.2% vs realized 19.7%, +8.5 points) and Gold the cheapest (+2.7 points). Realized vol percentiles over one year: S&P 500 98th, Nasdaq 100 96th, Russell 2000 84th, Euro Stoxx 50 69th, WTI Crude 68th, Gold 46th, Silver 39th, Natural Gas 50th, Brent Crude 72th, Copper 27th, Aluminium 43th, Wheat 2th, Corn 29th, Soybeans 0th.

sections.title: WTI crude
paragraphs: OVX at 60.3 (69th pct 1y) against 56.5% realized on the front future. The CLZ26 / CLZ27 calendar spread is +22.3%: the curve is in backwardation.
Samuelson effect today: CLZ26 (0.5 months out) realizes 44% against 21% for CLX27 at 11 months. News hits the front of the curve; the back is anchored by marginal cost.
Selling crude vol at the OVX level earned +4.3 points on average in backwardation (positive 74% of days, worst -40.4) versus -0.6 in the other regime.

sections.title: Scheduled events
paragraphs: Next FOMC decision: 2026-12-09 (33 days). It is outside the 9-day window, so VIX9D carries no identifiable event premium today.

Over 95 meetings since 2015 the term structure priced an average 0.68% move and the S&P realized 0.80% (ratio 1.09, realized above implied on 35% of meetings, max ratio 6.3x on 2024-06-12). Event vol is fairly priced; the generic month is not: the carry lives in the days with no scheduled news.

sections.title: Skew (SPY 30d, last snapshot)
paragraphs: Snapshot 2026-11-06: ATM 22.3%, 25-delta put 28.1%, 25-delta call 17.8%, risk reversal -10.27 points, butterfly +0.65. 8 snapshot day(s) in the history so far.

ideas.title: Sell WTI vol at the OVX level
ideas.instrument: USO / CL 1m variance at the OVX (crude ATM vol sits about 5% below OVX)
ideas.thesis: OVX 60.3 against 56.5% realized. In backwardation the crude variance premium averaged +4.3 points, positive 74% of days. Scarcity regimes have paid the seller.

ideas.title: Sell 1-month S&P variance at the VIX
ideas.instrument: 1m variance swap at the VIX, held to expiry (the premium sits in the wings, not at the money)
ideas.thesis: With the curve in backwardation, the forward premium (VIX today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.3 points in this bucket and was positive 79% of the time.

ideas.title: Sell the 1-month ATM S&P straddle, delta-hedged daily
ideas.instrument: SPX / SPY 1m ATM straddle at the ATM vol (about 0.8 x VIX), hedged at each close
ideas.condition: VIX - HAR+IV gap in the '4 to 6' bucket (+5.2 pts today)
ideas.thesis: The market charges +5.2 points over the debiased model. In this bucket the straddle kept -0.06% of spot per trade after hedge costs, 53% winners.

stats.unconditional: all 261 trades since 2005: -0.13% avg, 54% hit, worst -9.8% (Sep 2008)

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime (expected P&L per unit of tail). Conditioning variables: the VIX minus HAR+IV gap bucket, the VIX / VIX3M curve bucket, the WTI Dec/Dec curve regime, the FOMC calendar. Gross of financing, net of hedge costs where stated.
caveats: Free data: Yahoo Finance closes and CBOE indices. Option quotes are delayed; implied vols are rebuilt from mids with Black-76.
Conditional statistics are in-sample averages over overlapping daily windows; treat small buckets as indicative.

The straddle backtest sells at the S&P ATM vol (VXO / sqrt(30/22) to 2021, then VIX x a ratio modelled on VIX and SKEW), with 1 bp hedge cost and 0.5 vol point bid-ask; no margin, no financing. Sold at the VIX it would look far better: VIX prices the skew, an ATM straddle does not get paid for it.
